## Checklist

- [ ] Branch was created from the latest `main` (not committed directly to `main`)
- [ ] Branch name follows the convention (`feature/...`, `fix/...`, `test/...`, `docs/...`, `chore/...`)
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for this change
- [ ] Tests were run locally and pass (or the pre-push hook passed)
- [ ] At least one teammate has been requested as a reviewer
- [ ] CI is green — the required check is **CI Success**
- [ ] Documentation (README / docs / SRS / SAD / STP) updated if behavior or requirements changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or local environment files are included
